# Confirm profile updates appear in every open tab

## What & Why
The shared storage listener also covers profile data, but the cross-tab browser coverage currently exercises answers and applications only. A profile-specific check protects the personal details users rely on across the workspace.

## Done looks like
- A profile saved in one open tab appears in another tab without a reload
- A profile edit made in either tab replaces the older rendered details in the other tab
- Browser coverage fails if profile synchronization regresses
